title: Singapore’s June 30 Crypto Deadline Forces Firms to Secure License or Exit
body: MAS will require any Singapore-based crypto entity serving overseas clients to obtain a licence or to cease cross-border operations The financial institution has stated they will issue licences only in extremely limited circumstances Non-compliance leads to up to $200,000 fines and up to three years of imprisonment Effective June 30, the Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) will require any Singapore-based crypto entity serving overseas clients to obtain a Digital Token Service Provider (DTSP) licence or immediately cease cross-border operations. Regardless of business size, revenue share, or server location, this covers companies, partnerships, or individuals if they offer token services beyond Singapore. As for the services covered, it includes token transfers, exchanges, custody, advisory, and promotion. While licences can be issued, MAS has stated it will do so only in extremely limited circumstances due to persistent anti-money laundering and counter-terror financing concerns. title: Byreal Signals Dawn of Onchain Capital Markets with Bold Debut at Solana APEX
body: BUDAPEST, Hungary, June 24th, 2025, Chainwire At one of the most anticipated fireside sessions of Solana APEX, three industry heavyweights—Solana Foundation President Lily Liu, Bybit Co-founder and CEO Ben Zhou, and Byreal Founder Emily Bao—came together to deliver more than just a product launch. They delivered a vision: one where real assets finally flow seamlessly across centralized and decentralized financial systems. The crowd packed into the room, and the mood was electric. The conversation wasn’t just about Byreal—it was about what the future of DeFi should look like. “Onchain capital markets for traditional assets are closer than we think,” said Lily Liu, opening with a sweeping vision of Solana’s next chapter. She laid out Solana’s ambition to become the premier ecosystem for capital—supporting everything from memecoins to money market funds, and with an eye firmly on real-world assets (RWAs). Liu emphasized the trillion-dollar opportunity: a future where tokenized equities like those planned in the upcoming xStocks project could give global investors exposure to public markets (outside the U.S.), all built natively onchain. Ben Zhou, CEO of Bybit, reinforced this convergence, sharing how Bybit is aggressively bridging TradFi and Web3. “It is no longer CEX versus DEX. Now it’s CEX plus DEX,” Zhou declared. He pointed to Bybit’s new MiCAR license in Europe, enabling direct crypto access via bank accounts, and the expansion of TradFi instruments like indices, forex, and stock CFDs on Bybit’s platform. But most crucially, he spotlighted Byreal—a project incubated by Bybit to meet the growing need for deep, programmable, onchain liquidity. At the heart of the fireside was Byreal’s founder, Emily Bao, who took the mic with equal parts clarity and conviction. “A great exchange doesn’t just facilitate transactions—it reveals value.” She dissected the current state of DeFi, calling out the distortion created by overhyped projects and mismatched valuations from the last bull run. She positioned Byreal as a permissioned DEX on Solana, curating highly-demanded assets and providing real trading infrastructure for real users. “We’re not here to compete for market share. We’re here to bridge fragmented liquidity and help high-potential projects grow. We want traders to discover the next great asset early—and with conviction.” Byreal, she explained, is designed to sit at the intersection of CeFi depth and DeFi access. Its smart routing engine will unify fragmented order books and bring institutional-grade execution to the onchain world. Byreal’s public beta drops June 30. Launching first on Solana. It integrates DEX, Launch, and Vault into a unified smart routing architecture, forming a full-cycle growth engine that supports asset discovery, trading, and yield generation across multiple ecosystems. title: USDT supply hits $156.1b all-time high, 90% on Tron and Ethereum
body: Tether’s USDT reached an all-time high in supply at $156.1 billion, with most of the stablecoin circulating on Tron and Ethereum. Despite renewed hype around Circle, Tether continues to dominate the stablecoin market. On Tuesday, June 24, USDT’s outstanding supply hit an all-time high of $156.1 billion . Notably, 90% of that supply is concentrated on just two networks: Ethereum and Tron. USDT outstanding supply | Source: Token terminal Over half of USDT stablecoins, or 50.47%, are now on Tron (TRX) , while almost 40% are on Ethereum (ETH) . Less than 10% of USDT supply is distributed across other blockchains, including BNB Chain, Solana, Cosmos, Avalanche, and others. Circle’s USDC has gained more traction on many of these smaller chains. For instance, Solana hosts nearly $7.5 billion worth of USDC compared to just $2.3 billion of USDT. Still, despite USDC’s growing popularity, USDT’s dominance has remained largely stable. Stablecoin dominance, with USDT and USDC in the lead | Source: DefiLlama Currently, USDT accounts for 62.10% of stablecoin supply across all chains, while USDC holds around 24%. However, USDT saw a dip in dominance near the end of 2024, coinciding with the implementation of the European Union’s MiCA stablecoin regulations. You might also like: Coinbase delists Tether, other MiCA noncompliant stablecoins What’s the future for USDT? Instead of trying to comply with MiCA regulation, Tether chose to withdraw from the market completely. It had discontinued its EURT stablecoin , as well as faced delisting on several major exchanges. Still, Tether’s leadership would not relent, declining to enact full reserve transparency. Still, the passage of the U.S. GENIUS Act could pose new problems for Tether, where it controls a dominant market share. However, experts are not convinced that the GENIUS Act would force the Tether out of the U.S. market. For now, Tether’s strategic focus remains on Asia, where it continues to be a preferred option for crypto payments—particularly on the Tron network. title: Mastercard Expands Stablecoin Push With Paxos, Fiserv and PayPal Integrations
body: Mastercard (MA) is doubling down on stablecoins with a series of partnerships and product expansions aimed at embedding regulated digital dollars into the everyday payments network. The payments giant said on Tuesday it will integrate several stablecoins including PayPal’s PYUSD, the Paxos-led Global Dollar (USDG) and Fiserv’s recently unveiled FIUSD into its global network, which already includes support for Circle’s USDC. It is also introducing stablecoin transactions for cross-border payments through Mastercard Move. The company also said it's also working with financial technology provider Fiserv (FI) to bring FIUSD support to its card products, on- and offramps and merchant settlements, and will let consumers spend both fiat and stablecoin balances under a single interface with Mastercard One Credential. The initiatives are the latest examples of global banks and payment firms racing to embrace stablecoins , a type of digital currency with prices anchored to an external asset such as fiat currencies, into their offerings. It's a $260 billion, and rapidly growing, asset class and promises programmable transactions and faster, cheaper payments than through traditional banking channels. Institutional adoption is accelerating after the U.S. Senate passed the GENIUS Act to regulate the stablecoin sector. "We expect that consumers and businesses will continue to use fiat currency with their Mastercard cards for most use cases," Jorn Lambert, chief product officer at Mastercard, said in a blog post . "But regulated stablecoins are undoubtedly part of the evolution of digital payments." These moves mean financial institutions and businesses could soon mint, redeem and settle transactions using select stablecoins, while consumers may use them in the same way they would use traditional currencies for transfers and payments, including at the firm’s 150 million merchant locations. The stablecoin integrations join existing digital asset offerings, which span card programs with crypto firms that allow users to spend their crypto holdings to merchant settlements and tokenized bank deposits . Future plans include enabling programmable payments via Mastercard's Multi-Token Network . Read more: Mastercard Says It Has Moved Beyond Experimentation in Crypto, Focused on 'Real Solutions'

title: Circle Stock: The Powerhouse Driving VanEck’s Digital Asset Index
body: BitcoinWorld Circle Stock: The Powerhouse Driving VanEck’s Digital Asset Index The world of digital assets is constantly evolving, and a recent development has put a significant spotlight on Circle (CRCL) stock . Its prominent position as the largest component within VanEck’s digital asset index signals a pivotal moment for crypto investment and the broader blockchain ecosystem. This isn’t just a minor shift; it’s a testament to Circle’s growing influence and the increasing institutional confidence in the infrastructure supporting the digital economy. Why Circle Stock’s Dominance in VanEck’s Index Matters In a significant move reported by Cointelegraph, Circle stock has ascended to become the largest constituent within the VanEck digital asset index . Accounting for a substantial 13% of the index, up from 11% just days prior, this elevation underscores a critical trend: the rising prominence of regulated, infrastructure-focused companies in the digital asset space. But what does this mean for you, the investor, or simply an observer of the crypto landscape? Institutional Validation: Circle’s increased weighting reflects a growing institutional acknowledgment of its fundamental role in the crypto economy, particularly through its stablecoin, USDC. Exposure to Core Infrastructure: Investing in companies like Circle offers exposure not just to speculative digital assets, but to the underlying technology and services that enable the entire ecosystem. Diversification within Digital Assets: For those looking beyond direct cryptocurrency holdings, an index like VanEck’s provides a diversified basket of publicly traded companies deeply involved in the space. This development is more than just a rebalancing act; it’s a clear indicator of where smart money might be heading within the digital asset sphere. The Unwavering Influence of the USDC Stablecoin You can’t talk about Circle without immediately thinking of USDC stablecoin . As the issuer of one of the world’s leading regulated, fully reserved stablecoins, Circle’s valuation is intrinsically linked to the success and adoption of USDC. Why is this so significant? Stability in Volatility: In a market known for its wild price swings, USDC offers a haven of stability, pegged 1:1 to the US dollar. This makes it crucial for trading, remittances, and decentralized finance (DeFi) applications. Regulatory Compliance: Unlike some other stablecoins, USDC prides itself on its transparency and adherence to regulatory standards. This commitment to compliance is a major draw for institutional investors and traditional financial entities seeking secure entry points into crypto. Global Utility: USDC facilitates billions of dollars in transactions daily, acting as a critical bridge between traditional finance and the decentralized world. Its utility across various blockchain networks further solidifies Circle’s position as a foundational player. The increasing usage and trust in USDC stablecoin directly contribute to Circle’s revenue streams and market valuation, making its stock an attractive proposition for those seeking exposure to the growth of digital payments and programmable money. Navigating Digital Asset Investment with VanEck’s Index The VanEck digital asset index isn’t just a random collection of crypto companies; it’s a carefully curated benchmark designed to track the performance of the largest and most liquid publicly traded companies in the crypto space. Think of it as a specialized S&P 500 for the digital economy. But how does such an index work, and why is it valuable for those interested in digital asset investment ? The index methodology typically involves: Selection Criteria: Companies must meet specific liquidity, market capitalization, and revenue thresholds from digital asset activities. Weighting: Components are weighted based on factors like market capitalization, with larger, more influential companies (like Circle) receiving a higher allocation. Regular Rebalancing: The index is periodically reviewed and adjusted to ensure it accurately reflects the evolving landscape of the digital asset industry. For investors, this index provides a transparent and diversified way to gain exposure to the crypto sector without having to pick individual crypto winners or manage complex digital wallets. It represents a more traditional, equity-based approach to participating in the digital revolution. Is a Crypto ETF Your Gateway to Digital Assets? While direct investment in Circle stock is one avenue, many investors prefer the convenience and diversification offered by a crypto ETF . VanEck’s Digital Transformation ETF (VDE) offers precisely this opportunity, allowing investors to indirectly invest in the very index where Circle holds its dominant position. What are the pros and cons of using a crypto ETF for your digital asset investment strategy? Benefits of a Crypto ETF: Ease of Access: Tradeable on traditional stock exchanges, ETFs are accessible through standard brokerage accounts, simplifying the investment process. Diversification: Instead of betting on a single company, an ETF provides exposure to a basket of companies involved in the crypto space, spreading risk. Professional Management: ETFs are managed by professionals who handle the selection, weighting, and rebalancing of assets. No Custody Worries: You don’t need to worry about securing private keys or managing cryptocurrency wallets. Considerations for a Crypto ETF: Indirect Exposure: You’re investing in companies that support the crypto ecosystem, not directly in cryptocurrencies themselves. Management Fees: ETFs typically charge an expense ratio for their management services. Market Risk: While diversified, these ETFs are still subject to the volatility and regulatory risks inherent in the digital asset sector. For many, a crypto ETF serves as an ideal entry point, bridging the gap between traditional finance and the innovative world of digital assets. Strategic Implications and Future Outlook for Circle Circle’s elevated status within the VanEck digital asset index is more than just a headline; it carries significant strategic implications for the company and the broader market. This enhanced visibility could attract even more institutional capital, further solidifying Circle’s market position. However, like any rapidly evolving sector, challenges remain. Key Considerations: Regulatory Landscape: The stablecoin market is under increasing scrutiny globally. Circle’s ability to navigate evolving regulations will be crucial for its continued success. Competition: While USDC is a leader, it faces strong competition from other stablecoins and central bank digital currencies (CBDCs) in development. Technological Advancement: Staying at the forefront of blockchain innovation and expanding USDC’s utility across new platforms and use cases will be vital. Despite these challenges, Circle’s strategic focus on regulatory compliance, transparency, and building a robust financial infrastructure positions it well for long-term growth. Its significant weighting in a prominent index like VanEck’s indicates that the market sees its fundamental value proposition as strong and enduring. Conclusion: A New Era for Digital Asset Investment The rise of Circle stock to the top of the VanEck digital asset index marks a significant milestone in the maturation of the cryptocurrency market. It highlights a shift towards valuing companies that provide essential infrastructure and regulated services, rather than solely focusing on the speculative trading of digital coins. With the unwavering influence of the USDC stablecoin as its backbone, Circle exemplifies how traditional finance and innovative blockchain technology are converging. For investors, this development underscores the growing accessibility of digital asset investment through vehicles like a crypto ETF , offering diversified and professionally managed exposure to this exciting sector. As the digital economy continues to expand, companies like Circle, and the indices that track them, will play an increasingly vital role in shaping the future of finance. title: Riot Games unplugs Minecraft copy game and development studio behind it
body: Riot Games is officially closing Hypixel Studios, the developer behind Hytale , a Minecraft-inspired sandbox game that has been in development since 2015. CEO Aaron Donaghey, also known as Noxy, announced the shutdown in a statement posted on X, saying the studio will wind down “over the next few months.” Donaghey said the decision was “painful” but unavoidable after years of development struggles. “ This is not the outcome any of us, at Hypixel or at Riot, wanted. But after years of pushing forward, adapting, and exploring every possible path, it became clear we couldn’t bring Hytale to life in a way that truly delivered on its promise ,” Noxy wrote . A Difficult Update About Hytale Hey Everyone, Today, I shared some incredibly tough news with the Hypixel Studios team: we’re ending development on Hytale and beginning the process of winding down Hypixel Studios over the next few months. This is not the outcome any of us – at… — Noxy @ Hypixel Studios (@Noxywoxy) June 23, 2025 Hypixel Studios closes its doors permanently Hypixel Studios was founded in 2015 by the creators of a popular Minecraft server network. It almost immediately commenced the development of Hytale , a voxel-based sandbox game involving building and RPG elements. The game released a trailer in 2018 that garnered over 60 million views. Riot Games acquired Hypixel in 2020 for an undisclosed amount, with plans to launch a beta in 2021. That beta never materialized, and development was repeatedly delayed. In 2021, Hypixel decided to completely change Hytale ’s game engine to solve the technical shortcomings which also reset the development timeline. Even after the reboot, Donaghey said the project still “wasn’t as far along as it needed to be” to meet the development team’s goals. “Our technical ambitions grew more complex,” he surmised. Donaghey explained that the team debated whether to scale back features or extend timelines, but choice included sacrifices that could have lost what made the game compelling. “ Each alternative would have meant compromising on what made Hytale special in the first place . This is a painful decision. We still believe in Hytale. We believe in the team, and are forever grateful to every member, past or present, who poured their love into the game ,” the CEO said. Donaghey thanks Riot Games for its support Donaghey told his followers that Riot Games supported them throughout Hytale ’s troubled development, and will continue doing so during the studio’s closure. He called Riot’s involvement “thoughtful” and “human,” adding that the team has given them “generous severance and resources to find what’s next.” “ Game development is brutally hard ,” he continued, “ especially when you’re trying to build something original that speaks to a creative, passionate community. ” He credited the studio’s team for its commitment through demands and thanked the community for believing in the project during its long development cycle. “ To our community: thank you ,” he remarked. “ Your belief in Hytale kept us going through thick and thin .” Though the game will not be released, he noted that the team is proud of what they built and will carry the lessons forward. “ Even though we’re closing this chapter, the spirit of Hytale and everything we hoped it could be will stay with us .” Despite the studio’s closure, Hypixel’s popular Minecraft server will not be affected. That server is managed independently from Hypixel Studios and will continue operations as usual. Minecraft community faces cyber threat Hytale’s shutdown news comes just five days after the Minecraft community uncovered a malware campaign targeting players. Hackers are now using a multi-stage Java-based attack to steal data from active players, according to a report by cybersecurity firm Check Point. The campaign, first detected in March 2025, uses fake modding tools disguised as cheat scripts for Minecraft, such as Oringo and Taunahi. The malicious tools are distributed through GitHub repositories and require a working Minecraft runtime to execute, specifically dangerous to day-to-day players of the game. title: SHIB Gains More Than 10% in 24 Hours as Exchange Reserve Surges to $929 Million

title: New COIN Act Targets White House Crypto Ventures Amid Trump’s $57M DeFi Earnings
body: U.S. Senator Adam Schiff has introduced new legislation seeking to bar the President, Vice President, and their families from profiting through cryptocurrency ventures while holding office. A Direct Response to Trump’s Crypto Activity The bill, titled the Curbing Officials’ Income and Nondisclosure (COIN) Act, arrives at a moment of heightened scrutiny over the intersection of political power and digital asset markets, particularly following a wave of concern stemming from Trump’s reported $57.4 million earnings from his DeFi venture, as disclosed in recent financial filings. Senator Schiff explicitly tied the bill’s introduction to Trump’s crypto activities, stating, “President Donald Trump’s cryptocurrency dealings have raised significant ethical, legal, and constitutional concerns over his use of the office of the presidency to enrich himself and his family. That’s why I am introducing legislation to prevent the financial exploitation of any digital assets by public officials, including the president and the First Family.” Provisions of the COIN Act The proposed legislation would impose a strict prohibition on issuing, sponsoring, or endorsing any form of cryptocurrency, including stablecoins, meme coins, and NFTs, by sitting U.S. Presidents, Vice Presidents, senior Executive Branch officials, Members of Congress, and their immediate families. Any public official found violating these provisions could face civil penalties equal to their profits and a prison sentence of up to five years. Further, the bill mandates disclosure of any sale of digital assets exceeding $1,000 in value, aiming to improve transparency around financial interests in digital assets among public officials. Trump and Family Profiting from Crypto Policies Trump’s crypto activity has been steadily expanding since last year, with the former president launching ventures such as World Liberty Financial, which has issued a stablecoin, and promoting meme coins prior to his inauguration. Additionally, Trump’s media firm, Trump Media & Technology Group, has raised $2.5 billion for a Bitcoin reserve and is reportedly developing other crypto-related financial products. A Legislative Gap Left by the GENIUS Act Schiff’s bill comes just days after the Senate passed the GENIUS Act, which establishes a regulatory framework for payment stablecoins. While Senate Democrats initially pushed to include language barring public officials from profiting through digital assets, those provisions were ultimately excluded before the bill advanced to the House. Trump has since encouraged lawmakers to approve the GENIUS Act swiftly and with minimal amendments. Schiff’s COIN Act appears to be a direct effort to address the regulatory loophole left behind, particularly as political figures increasingly engage with the rapidly growing crypto economy. title: Lumia integrates modular cross-chain infrastructure through Avail collaboration
body: Real-world asset tokenization platform Lumia is integrating Avail into its on-chain infrastructure, marking a shift from siloed blockchains to a modular, interoperable infrastructure. According to a press release received by crypto.news, the collaboration will integrate the Avail Stack infrastructure into the RWA chain to unlock more liquidity and interoperability and ensure data-level secure verification for tokenized real-world assets. The Avail Stack is a full-stack blockchain infrastructure solution designed to address scalability, interoperability, and liquidity challenges in the blockchain space. It combines three core components, which includes data availability, cross-chain layering, and Avail’s security mechanism. Its Avail Nexus provides multichain messaging and secure asset movement, laying out the foundation for cross‑chain RWA liquidity. With access to Nexus, Lumia can support multi-chain RWA liquidity as part of its efforts to expand on cross-chain operations. The partnership marks a shift in the infrastructure built on Lumia as it moves away from the traditional siloed blockchains to a more modular and interoperable infrastructure. It equips the RWA Chain with Avail’s scalable data‑availability layer, which features KZG polynomial commitments, Data Availability Sampling, erasure coding, and light‑client architecture. The Avail and Lumia integration is scheduled to debut along with major other functionalities and upgrades, such as Lumia Hub, which will launch with Avail DA integration. The upgrade will allow users and builders to issue tokenized RWAs with light-node NFT functionalities. Echoing Ali’s sentiments, Avail co-founder Anurag Arjun said the potential of tokenization will fully be realized once assets can be liquified, programmable, and globally verifiable on a data-level. “We need infrastructure that guarantees a composable and interoperable environment; one where tokenized assets aren’t locked into singular ecosystems, but can move freely across chains with compliance, security and scalability embedded at the base layer,” said Arjun. Here, they were depositing Bitcoin before a price drop, suggesting a strategic positioning or an early read on the market. This raises a crucial question: were these retail traders privy to information, or were they simply exhibiting a heightened sense of market intuition? The answer could have profound implications for how we analyze market sentiment and predict future movements. Decoding Proactive Retail Trader Behavior on Binance BTC The concept of retail trader behavior being “proactive” is a fascinating deviation from the norm. What could explain this unusual foresight among a group often perceived as the last to react? Several theories emerge when looking at Binance BTC activity: Sophisticated On-Chain Analysis: A growing number of retail traders are now equipped with advanced tools and knowledge to analyze on-chain data, exchange flows, and whale movements. They might have spotted early signs of institutional selling or large whale deposits that often precede price corrections. Network Effects and Information Spread: In the age of social media and crypto communities, information (and sometimes misinformation) spreads rapidly. Perhaps early signals were shared within private groups or communities, allowing a segment of retail traders to act swiftly. Accumulation for Shorting/Hedging: It’s possible some retail traders were depositing BTC onto the exchange not to sell immediately, but to prepare for shorting opportunities or to hedge existing long positions. This would require foresight into a potential downturn. Coincidence or Lucky Guess: While less glamorous, it’s also possible that these spikes were a confluence of individual decisions that, by chance, aligned with the market’s direction. However, the timing and magnitude make this less likely to be purely random. The fact that this occurred on Binance, a behemoth in the crypto space, adds another layer of significance. Binance’s sheer volume and user base mean that even slight shifts in retail trader behavior on its platform can serve as a powerful barometer for broader market sentiment. The exchange’s liquidity and range of trading options also make it a prime location for both immediate transactions and strategic positioning. Retail Bitcoin inflows to Binance preceded a notable price correction. Understanding Broader Crypto Market Trends: A Retail Perspective These recent events highlight the evolving role of retail participants in shaping crypto market trends . While institutional money often drives large, sustained movements, the cumulative effect of millions of retail decisions can create significant short-term volatility and provide early signals. Historically, market analysis often focused on institutional flows, derivatives data, and macroeconomic indicators. However, the Binance retail inflow data suggests that retail activity, when observed keenly, can offer unique insights. This particular incident underscores: The Power of Aggregated Retail Data: Individual retail actions might seem small, but when aggregated, they can reveal powerful trends. Tools that track exchange inflows/outflows are becoming indispensable for market analysts. Decentralization of Information: With more data available to the public, the line between “smart money” and “dumb money” is blurring. Sophisticated analysis is no longer exclusive to large institutions. Early Warning Systems: A sudden surge in deposits to exchanges, especially from retail addresses, could be an early warning sign of impending selling pressure or profit-taking, influencing crypto market trends . However, it’s crucial to approach such data with caution. Not every retail inflow surge will lead to a price drop, and market dynamics are influenced by countless factors. These events serve as a reminder that the crypto market is a complex adaptive system, where various participants interact in unpredictable ways. Navigating the BTC Price Drop: Actionable Insights for Traders The recent BTC price drop after significant retail inflows offers valuable lessons for any trader looking to navigate the volatile crypto landscape. How can you leverage such insights and protect your portfolio? Here are some actionable insights: Monitor On-Chain Metrics: Pay attention to exchange inflow/outflow data, especially for major exchanges like Binance. Implement Robust Risk Management: Regardless of market signals, never invest more than you can afford to lose. Use stop-loss orders to limit potential losses during sudden downturns like the recent BTC price drop . Diversify Your Portfolio: Don’t put all your eggs in one basket. While Bitcoin is a dominant asset, a diversified portfolio can help mitigate risks associated with sudden price movements in a single asset. Avoid Emotional Trading: The crypto market thrives on fear and greed. Data points like these are useful, but they should inform your strategy, not dictate impulsive decisions. Stick to your trading plan. Stay Informed, But Verify: Follow reputable analysts and news sources, but always cross-reference information. The crypto space is rife with speculation and misinformation. The proactive nature of these retail traders, whether by design or fortunate timing, serves as a powerful reminder that vigilance and informed decision-making are paramount. The market is always speaking; the challenge lies in learning to listen. A New Dawn for Retail Influence? The recent surge in Bitcoin retail inflows to Binance, preceding a notable BTC price drop , marks a compelling chapter in the evolving narrative of cryptocurrency markets. It challenges the long-held perception of retail traders as merely reactive participants, suggesting a growing sophistication and perhaps even a leading role in signaling future movements. This isn’t just about a couple of data points; it’s about the potential for retail trader behavior to become a more significant indicator for broader crypto market trends . As more individuals gain access to advanced analytical tools and communities, the collective wisdom of the crowd, particularly on platforms like Binance BTC , could become an increasingly vital component of market analysis. For investors and enthusiasts alike, this serves as a powerful reminder: keep your eyes on the data, for the whispers of the market might just come from the most unexpected voices. title: Chainlink, Mastercard Tie-Up to Let Nearly 3B Cardholders Buy Crypto On-Chain
body: Chainlink and Mastercard have linked their networks so more than three billion Mastercard holders can purchase cryptocurrencies directly on-chain. The service folds several players into a single flow. Shift4 processes the card payment, zerohash custodies fiat currency and delivers crypto liquidity, while XSwap and Uniswap execute the final token swap on decentralized markets. Chainlink’s interoperability protocol stitches those steps together, passing transaction data between the card network and multiple blockchains, according to an announcement shared with CoinDesk. Raj Dhamodharan, who leads blockchain efforts at Mastercard, said the firm wants to “bridge the gap between onchain commerce and offchain transactions.” The deal helps enable a “critical connection between the traditional payments world and the over three billion cardholders in the Mastercard user base,” according to Chainlink co-founder Sergey Nazarov. Mastercard has been slowly moving deeper into the cryptocurrency space. Just last month, the firm partnered with MoonPay to let users spend stablecoins at more than 150 million merchants worldwide. Similarly, back in April Kraken and Mastercard teamed up to introduce cryptocurrency debit cards. title: Ethereum Exchange Traded Funds (ETF) Passed Critical Level in 11th Month! Here Are the Details
body: Spot Ethereum exchange-traded funds (ETFs) traded in the United States have surpassed the $4 billion cumulative net inflow threshold in the 11th month of their launch. US Spot Ethereum ETFs Surpass $4 Billion Net Inflow Threshold This milestone was surpassed on Monday, June 23, with daily inflows of $100.7 million. Spot Ethereum ETFs began trading on July 23, 2024. Despite recent geopolitical tensions in the Middle East, the high daily inflows indicate continued investor confidence. Fidelity Takes Lead, BlackRock Second Fidelity’s FETH fund had the biggest inflow on Monday, with $60.5 million. BlackRock’s ETHA ETF, which usually leads, came in second with $25.8 million inflows. Grayscale’s ETHE fund saw $9 million inflows, while its ETH mini product saw $5.4 million. Other ETFs saw no movement. Spot Ethereum ETFs, like Bitcoin ETFs, have achieved a positive balance sheet overall despite the large outflows from the high-fee Grayscale ETHE fund. Grayscale ETHE fund alone has seen $4.3 billion in outflows to date. Without these outflows, total net inflows could have reached $8.3 billion. Following these exits, the Grayscale ETHE fund's market share fell from 89.7% to 30.2%, while BlackRock's ETHA fund rose to the lead with a share of 31.8%. Fidelity FETH ranked third with 18%, and Grayscale ETH ranked fourth with 15.5%. “$4 billion net inflow including Grayscale outflows, I think that’s quite a feat. If you recall, some experts suggested that Bitcoin ETFs could raise a maximum of $5 billion in the first year. Expectations are constantly being updated,” ETF Store President Nate Geraci said in an assessment on the social media platform X. Total trading volume of spot Ethereum ETFs reached $89 billion, with daily volume on June 23 at $840 million. While this figure is still below the $1.5 billion daily peak in February, it remains above average. Bitcoin ETFs Still Ahead For comparison, U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs saw net inflows of $34.7 billion in the first 11 months since their launch in January 2024. That figure has now reached $47.3 billion. On June 23, there was a net inflow of $350.8 million into Bitcoin ETFs. This means a total inflow of $2.8 billion in the last 10 days. BlackRock’s IBIT product was again prominent in the inflows. *This is not investment advice. Continue Reading: Ethereum Exchange Traded Funds (ETF) Passed Critical Level in 11th Month! title: Texas Unleashes Bold Crypto Seizure Law: A Game-Changer for Digital Asset Forfeiture
body: BitcoinWorld Texas Unleashes Bold Crypto Seizure Law: A Game-Changer for Digital Asset Forfeiture The world of cryptocurrency, often lauded for its decentralized nature and promise of financial freedom, is increasingly intersecting with traditional legal frameworks. In a significant development for the digital asset space, Texas has taken a decisive step, enacting a new law that empowers the state to seize digital assets connected to criminal activities. This move marks a pivotal moment for the Texas crypto law landscape, sending a clear message about the state’s approach to illicit financial flows within the blockchain ecosystem. What Does the New Texas Crypto Law Entail? On June 20, 2023, Texas Senate Bill SB1498 officially became law, set to take effect on September 1. This legislation is not just another bureaucratic update; it represents a fundamental shift in how the state addresses financial crimes involving digital currencies. At its core, SB1498 grants law enforcement agencies and the state attorney the authority for crypto seizure when these assets are linked to specific criminal offenses. Wu Blockchain, a prominent crypto news source, highlighted on X (formerly Twitter) that a key provision mandates the storage of these seized digital assets in secure offline wallets. This detail underscores a commitment to safeguarding the assets once they are in state custody, a critical concern given the volatile and often irreversible nature of blockchain transactions. The implications of this law are far-reaching, touching upon aspects of privacy, property rights, and the very future of digital finance within the state. Why is Digital Asset Forfeiture Becoming a Global Priority? Texas’s recent legislative action isn’t an isolated event but rather part of a growing global trend. As cryptocurrencies gain mainstream adoption, they have also, unfortunately, become tools for various illicit activities, ranging from ransomware attacks and drug trafficking to money laundering and terrorist financing. Governments worldwide are grappling with how to effectively combat cryptocurrency crime without stifling innovation. The concept of digital asset forfeiture provides a powerful mechanism for authorities to disrupt criminal enterprises by stripping them of their ill-gotten gains. Historically, asset forfeiture has been a staple in fighting traditional crime, targeting everything from cash and real estate to vehicles and luxury goods. Applying this principle to the digital realm presents unique challenges but also significant opportunities. Nations like the United States, through agencies such as the IRS and FBI, have already demonstrated success in seizing large sums of crypto from darknet markets and criminal networks. Texas is now solidifying its own legal framework to join these efforts, aiming to enhance its capabilities in this evolving frontier of law enforcement. How Will Crypto Seizure Practically Unfold in Texas? The operational specifics of how crypto seizure will be executed under SB1498 are crucial for both law enforcement and the public to understand. The law specifies that seized assets must be held in ‘secure offline wallets.’ This implies a rigorous protocol for custody, likely involving multi-signature wallets, hardware security modules (HSMs), and stringent access controls to prevent unauthorized access or loss. Here’s a simplified breakdown of the potential process: Identification and Tracing: Law enforcement agencies, often in collaboration with blockchain analytics firms, will first identify and trace cryptocurrency transactions linked to criminal activity. This involves sophisticated tools to de-anonymize transactions and link them to real-world identities. Legal Order: A court order, similar to those used for traditional asset seizures, will be required to legally confiscate the digital assets. This ensures due process and protects against arbitrary seizures. Seizure and Transfer: Once the order is obtained, the identified cryptocurrency will be transferred from the suspect’s control to a state-controlled, secure offline wallet. This step is technically complex and requires expertise in handling various blockchain protocols. Custody and Management: The state, likely through a designated agency or a specialized unit, will be responsible for the long-term custody and management of these seized assets. This includes monitoring their value, potentially liquidating them at appropriate times, and ensuring their security until a final legal disposition. Disposition: Post-conviction, the forfeited assets will typically be sold, with the proceeds often directed back into law enforcement budgets or victim compensation funds, similar to traditional asset forfeiture programs. This process highlights the need for specialized training for law enforcement personnel and a robust technical infrastructure to manage these digital assets effectively and securely. What are the Potential Benefits of This Texas Crypto Law? The enactment of this Texas crypto law carries several potential benefits, primarily aimed at enhancing public safety and the integrity of the financial system. Deterring Cryptocurrency Crime: By creating a clear legal pathway for seizure, the law acts as a powerful deterrent to criminals who might otherwise view cryptocurrencies as a safe haven for illicit gains. The knowledge that their digital wealth can be confiscated could significantly reduce the appeal of using crypto for illegal activities. Funding Law Enforcement: Proceeds from digital asset forfeiture can provide valuable resources to law enforcement agencies, enabling them to invest further in training, technology, and personnel needed to combat complex cybercrimes and financial fraud. Protecting Victims: In cases where victims have lost funds due to crypto-related scams or hacks, the ability to seize and liquidate stolen digital assets offers a potential avenue for restitution and recovery, providing a measure of justice. Enhancing Financial Security: By actively targeting illicit crypto flows, the law contributes to a more secure and transparent financial ecosystem, fostering greater trust in digital assets for legitimate use cases. Setting a Precedent: Texas’s proactive stance could serve as a model for other states and jurisdictions, encouraging a more unified and effective approach to blockchain regulation and enforcement across the country and globally. These benefits underscore the state’s commitment to adapting its legal tools to the evolving digital landscape, ensuring that justice can be served regardless of the medium used for criminal enterprise. Navigating the Challenges: What Hurdles Lie Ahead for Digital Asset Forfeiture? While the intentions behind the new Texas crypto law are clear, its implementation and long-term impact will undoubtedly face several challenges. The unique characteristics of digital assets present complexities not typically encountered with traditional forms of property. Technical Expertise: Law enforcement agencies will require significant investment in training and technology to effectively trace, seize, and manage a wide array of cryptocurrencies. This includes understanding different blockchain protocols, wallet types, and transaction mechanisms. Custody and Security: Storing seized digital assets in ‘secure offline wallets’ is a good start, but maintaining the security of these assets over long periods, especially given the constant evolution of cyber threats, will be a continuous challenge. The risk of hacks, accidental loss, or insider threats remains. Valuation Volatility: The highly volatile nature of cryptocurrencies poses a challenge for valuation and disposition. An asset seized today could be worth significantly less (or more) by the time it is legally forfeited and ready for sale, impacting the ultimate recovery value. Legal and Jurisdictional Complexities: Blockchain transactions often cross international borders, creating jurisdictional challenges. Furthermore, establishing clear legal ownership and proving a direct link to criminal activity can be more complex with digital assets than with physical ones. Privacy Concerns and Civil Liberties: Critics often raise concerns about potential overreach and the erosion of privacy. Ensuring that the law is applied judiciously, with robust checks and balances to protect the civil liberties of innocent individuals, will be paramount. The distinction between legitimate privacy and illicit anonymity is a fine line that needs careful navigation. Maintaining Public Trust: For the law to be truly effective, it must maintain public trust. This means transparent processes, clear guidelines, and accountability to prevent abuses of power and ensure that legitimate crypto users are not unduly targeted. Addressing these challenges will require ongoing collaboration between legal experts, technologists, and law enforcement, along with continuous adaptation of policies as the crypto landscape evolves. How Will This Law Impact Cryptocurrency Crime and Legitimate Users? The primary target of SB1498 is undoubtedly cryptocurrency crime . By empowering the state to seize illicit crypto, Texas aims to make the state a less attractive hub for criminals attempting to launder money, conduct ransomware attacks, or engage in other illegal activities using digital assets. For those involved in such activities, the risk profile has significantly increased. The law underscores that anonymity, while often associated with crypto, does not equate to impunity. Law enforcement is increasingly sophisticated in tracing transactions and identifying perpetrators. For legitimate cryptocurrency users and businesses in Texas, the impact should ideally be minimal, provided they operate within the bounds of the law. However, there could be indirect effects: Increased Scrutiny: Law enforcement’s enhanced capabilities might lead to increased scrutiny of suspicious transactions, which could inadvertently affect some legitimate users if their activities are misconstrued or if they interact with compromised wallets. Enhanced Compliance: Businesses dealing with crypto in Texas might face increased pressure to implement robust Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Know Your Customer (KYC) procedures to avoid inadvertently facilitating criminal activity. Clarity vs. Uncertainty: While the law provides clarity on the state’s power, it also introduces a new layer of legal complexity. Users should be aware of the implications, especially regarding the provenance of their digital assets. Ultimately, the goal is to create a safer environment for legitimate crypto adoption by making it harder for criminals to exploit the technology. This is a crucial step towards mainstream acceptance of digital assets. Actionable Insights for Texas Crypto Holders: Navigating New Blockchain Regulation? For anyone holding cryptocurrencies in Texas, understanding the implications of this new blockchain regulation is key. While the law targets criminal activity, being informed is always beneficial. Here are some actionable insights: Understand the Source of Your Funds: Always be aware of where your cryptocurrencies come from. If you are receiving funds from unknown sources or engaging in peer-to-peer transactions, exercise extreme caution and conduct due diligence. Use Reputable Platforms: When buying, selling, or storing crypto, use well-regulated and reputable exchanges and wallets that comply with AML/KYC regulations. These platforms often have better security and audit trails. Secure Your Private Keys: This remains paramount. Whether you use a hardware wallet, a software wallet, or an exchange, ensure your private keys are secure and never shared. The state’s ability to seize assets is predicated on identifying and accessing them; robust personal security practices reduce risk. Stay Informed: Keep abreast of evolving regulations and legal interpretations concerning digital assets. Laws can change, and staying informed helps you navigate the landscape responsibly. Consult Legal Counsel if Necessary: If you find yourself in a situation where your digital assets are questioned or implicated in an investigation, seek legal advice immediately from an attorney specializing in cryptocurrency law. This proactive approach can help legitimate users navigate the evolving legal landscape with confidence and ensure their assets remain secure and compliant. Looking Ahead: The Future of Blockchain Regulation in Texas and Beyond. The passage of SB1498 is more than just a single piece of legislation; it’s a clear signal of Texas’s intent to be a significant player in the evolving landscape of blockchain regulation . This law, focusing on digital asset forfeiture and crypto seizure , demonstrates a pragmatic approach to integrating digital assets into existing legal frameworks. We can anticipate several trends emerging from this development: Increased Collaboration: Expect greater collaboration between state and federal law enforcement agencies, as well as with private blockchain analytics firms, to enhance capabilities in tracing and seizing illicit crypto. Evolving Legal Precedents: As cases involving crypto seizure move through the courts, new legal precedents will be set, further refining the application of these laws. Technological Arms Race: The cat-and-mouse game between criminals using sophisticated anonymizing techniques and law enforcement employing advanced tracing tools will continue to escalate, driving innovation on both sides. Harmonization of Laws: Texas’s move could spur other states to develop similar legislation, potentially leading to a more harmonized approach to crypto regulation across the U.S. Focus on DeFi and NFTs: While the current law broadly covers ‘digital assets,’ future legislative efforts might specifically target emerging areas like decentralized finance (DeFi) and Non-Fungible Tokens (NFTs) as their use in illicit activities potentially grows. Texas is positioning itself at the forefront of a crucial regulatory shift, acknowledging that the digital frontier requires robust legal tools to ensure security and uphold justice. The implications of this law will ripple through the crypto community, influencing how digital assets are perceived, used, and regulated for years to come. Texas’s new law to seize cryptocurrencies tied to crimes marks a significant milestone in the ongoing effort to bring the digital asset world under a clear legal umbrella. Senate Bill SB1498, effective September 1, empowers the state to conduct crypto seizure , store assets securely, and actively combat cryptocurrency crime . While presenting clear benefits in deterring illicit activities and providing resources for law enforcement, it also brings forth challenges related to technical expertise, asset volatility, and civil liberties. This proactive step in blockchain regulation signifies a growing trend where states are adapting their legal frameworks to the complexities of the digital age. For legitimate crypto users, understanding this evolving Texas crypto law and practicing strong digital security are more important than ever. As the landscape continues to evolve, the balance between innovation, security, and individual rights will remain a critical point of discussion, shaping the future of digital asset adoption and enforcement. To learn more about the latest blockchain regulation trends, explore our article on key developments shaping digital asset forfeiture and institutional adoption. title: Strategy Stock Volatility Sinks to Historic Lows, Possibly Making Shares Less Attractive
body: Strategy (MSTR) is currently experiencing its lowest 10-day realized volatility since it first added bitcoin {BTC} to its balance sheet in 2020, according to Jeff Park , Head of Alpha Strategies at Bitwise Asset Management. Realized volatility refers to the actual historical movement of an asset's price over a specific period, in this case ten days. It is calculated using past price data and indicates how much the price has fluctuated in reality, as opposed to how much it is expected to fluctuate in the future. In addition to subdued historical price swings, MSTR’s implied volatility (IV) currently sits at 48.33 percent , which is among the lowest levels recorded for the stock in recent years. Implied volatility reflects the market’s forecast of a stock’s future volatility, derived from options prices. A lower IV suggests the options market is anticipating smaller price movements going forward. For comparison, MSTR’s IV peaked at 225% in November 2024, during a sharp rally in bitcoin prices following Donald Trump's U.S. presidential election victory. At that time, bitcoin traded above $95,000 and MSTR’s share price surged from $350 to a high of $525. As of now, MSTR shares are trading at $367. MSTR currently holds 592,345 BTC , but last week added just 245 BTC, marking its smallest weekly purchase since March. This slowdown in accumulation may suggest a saturation point, particularly as other public companies globally begin to adopt bitcoin treasury strategies. Furthermore, capital flows appear to be rotating from MSTR to smaller bitcoin-holding companies, many of which are experiencing strong performance in both share price and trading volume. Among them are Canada's LQWD Technologies Corp, which has risen about three-fold in recent days on its BTC treasury strategy. Notably, this marks the fourth consecutive week in which MSTR has not utilized its at-the-market (ATM) equity offering program. As a result, the company now trades at a 1.83x multiple to its net asset value (NAV) in bitcoin terms, known as mNAV. This multiple is calculated by dividing the company's enterprise value by the market value of its bitcoin holdings. Is MSTR yesterday's news? Led by Executive Chairman Michael Saylor, Strategy has benefited significantly in recent years from the company’s status as a high-beta, high-volatility proxy for bitcoin. This elevated volatility made MSTR particularly attractive to options traders and speculators, enabling outsized gains on both the upside and downside compared to BTC itself. However, as MSTR’s volatility compresses, that appeal may diminish. With less price movement, traders, investors, and speculators could begin reallocating capital to other, more volatile bitcoin-linked equities or assets that offer greater trading opportunities. In response, Strategy has also leaned into alternative financing strategies, including at-the-market offerings tied to its perpetual preferred stock tickers, STRK and STRF. These fixed-income products represent a strategic pivot, but whether they gain meaningful traction remains to be seen.

title: Shocking Amount of BTC Absorbed by Buyers During Recent Market Turmoil
body: Bitcoin (BTC) has once again surged past $105,000, propelled by the easing of geopolitical tensions in the Middle East; however, an even more noteworthy story lies beneath the surface: the market has absorbed a colossal wave of profit taking without collapsing. About 720,000 BTC, sold mainly by recent buyers since mid-April, has been met with an equally strong demand, preventing a more resounding crash despite a $66 billion surge in the Realized Cap of coins held for less than one month. Profit-Taking Meets Fresh Demand According to on-chain analyst Axel Adler Jr., the $66 billion increase in Realized Cap for the 0-1 month cohort since April 13 is definitive proof of large-scale profit realization by short-term holders. While such aggressive selling pressure would typically trigger significant downside, Adler highlighted a critical counterforce: new buyers entering the market have been steadily absorbing this massive supply. In his opinion , this offsetting has kept Bitcoin trading within a relatively narrow range in the last few weeks. However, his UTXO Block Profit/Loss Count Ratio Model indicates the profit-taking frenzy may have subsided, dropping from an extreme 34,000 points near BTC’s all-time high in May to just 216 points today. “Profitable sales have almost disappeared,” noted Adler, while the proportion of loss-realizing transactions has increased. The likeliest explanation is that the wave of eager sellers has largely passed, replaced by buyers accumulating at lower levels, reducing the immediate risk of a sharp crash. Meanwhile, the global markets are experiencing a sense of relief thanks to an unexpected ceasefire between Israel and Iran. U.S. President Donald Trump confirmed a “Complete and Total” cessation of hostilities, quelling fears of a deeper conflict. Following that, investors like Daan Crypto Trades and Michaël van de Poppe echoed cautious optimism on X, pointing out that reduced geopolitical risk could ease headline-driven volatility and help Bitcoin regain upward momentum. What’s Next for Bitcoin? Indeed, BTC has staged a noticeable recovery since dipping below the symbolic $100,000 mark after the U.S. unleashed airstrikes against several Iranian nuclear installations last week. As of this writing, the king cryptocurrency had climbed 3.8% in the last 24 hours to hover around $105,400 after going as high as $105,927 during the Asian trading session. On a weekly scale, it remains slightly underwater, down about 1.1%, which is a modest underperformance compared to the broader crypto market’s 0.4% gain over the same period. The asset also experienced a slight 1.7% dip over the last 30 days, reflecting recent liquidation cascades and historical Q3 headwinds. As analyst Benjamin Cowen previously highlighted , Bitcoin often struggles through the summer months. Past bull cycles saw steep drops of 25–35% between June and July before roaring back in late Q4. title: Ledger Reveals Recovery Key for Flex and Stax Wallets
body: Major crypto wallet maker Ledger has announced that its latest product, Ledger Recovery Key, is “coming soon.” According to the press release, this is a spare key for Ledger Flex and Ledger Stax wallets. It’s designed to make recovering access to assets simple, the team says. Users will be able to create an offline spare key alongside their 24 words, as well as the PIN code for it. The key connects directly to the Ledger device via NFC communication, with no intermediary. To recover access, they will tap the card and enter the PIN. “There is no limit to the number of spare keys that can be created,” the announcement says. “Creating a spare key is always optional, and can only be created by you with confirmation on your Ledger.” Source: Ledger Moreover, the novel product features a Secure Element at its core, the technology behind Ledger’s security. Also, anyone can review the Ledger Recovery Key code. A whitepaper will be available upon launch, while info is available on the Ledger GitHub . Charles Guillemet, Chief Technology Officer at Ledger, says that Ledger Recovery Key “has gone through extensive security testing internally at the hands of the Donjon,” the company’s team of white hat hackers. He claims that it also underwent “a comprehensive internal testing and external security audits,” receiving “extremely positive feedback from security researchers and industry leaders.” Meanwhile, the Ledger Recover service and the physical Recovery Key are “complementary.” The users can use one, both, or just the 24 words. The team will launch the new product “in the near future,” the team says. Attendees will get a first-hand look and a chance to buy these releases. Per the team, they offer both fans and collectors “a unique fusion of secure digital ownership and playful design.”The... Ledger Recovery Key: Copy of ‘Master Secret’ Per the whitepaper shared with Cryptonews , Ledger Recovery Key is not a hardware wallet. It’s not a tool to manage assets or sign transactions. Instead, the team explains, it’s a smart card that stores a copy of the “master secret” – from which stems the Secret Recovery Phrase – from the Ledger wallet. The only condition is that the wallet supports the NFC protocol, as this is how the key and the wallet communicate. Source: Ledger Meanwhile, Ledger launched its touchscreen Ledger Stax and Ledger Flex in 2024. The announcement says that these devices have “contributed to a new sales milestone of over 7.5 million Ledger devices sold worldwide.” However, the team argues that traditional backup methods are becoming less practical with time. In response, they launched Ledger Recover in 2023 as an optional paid service. It allows users to create encrypted fragments of their recovery phrase. “Since launching, Ledger Recover adoption has been strong, showing a clear demand for more recovery options,” it argues. Therefore, Ledger Recovery Key is another option in the recovery suite. All these features remain optional. Ledger provides the “fullest set of choices around recovery,” says Ian Rogers, Chief Experience Officer at Ledger. “With Ledger Recovery Key, we are making secure self-custody easy-to-use for everyone.” You may also like: Ledger Starts Shipping its New Ledger Stax Hardware Wallet After 18 Months French startup Ledger has finally begun shipping its latest Ledger Stax devices, nearly 18 months after their initial announcement. title: China adds new partners to its ¥175 trillion CIPS system in Central Asia
body: China is expanding the geographical coverage of its yuan-based international payment system, adding banks in Central Asia and other regions. The growing reach is likely to boost its annual business volume beyond the 175 trillion yuan (over $24 trillion) already registered last year. Following the latest wave of expansion, the central bank in Beijing is now offering clearing and settlement services in cross-border payments and trade using its fiat currency to financial institutions in almost 190 countries around the world. Central Asia’s Kyrgyzstan joins Chinese SWIFT alternative The Central Asian nation of Kyrgyzstan has recently connected to China’s Cross-border Interbank Payment System ( CIPS ), seen as an alternative to the well-established global system for international payments known as SWIFT (Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication). In an interview with the TASS news agency on Monday, the First Deputy Prime Minister of the former Soviet Republic, Daniyar Amangeldiev, noted his country is taking into account new trends and highlighted that CIPS is offering faster payments. Speaking after his participation in the St. Petersburg International Economic Forum (SPIEF), which gathered politicians and business leaders from almost 140 countries in Russia’s second largest city last week, the Kyrgyz official elaborated: “We have just recently connected to the CIPS. This is the Chinese system that will enable us to make payments in a more expedited way.” At the beginning of June, Kyrgyzstan’s finance minister and central bank governor met with Chinese Minister of Finance Lan Foan in Beijing. The two sides discussed cross-border payments and the linking of Bishkek’s state-owned banks to China’s infrastructure in the field. “This step will create a secure and stable channel for bilateral settlements in yuan, reduce transaction costs, and decrease dependence on settlements through third currencies,” the Kyrgyz finance ministry insisted in a statement at the time. China pushes CIPS expansion in Africa and the Middle East Kyrgyzstan revealed it is joining the CIPS after earlier this month, the People’s Republic announced it had added another six banks to its cross-border payment system, noting these are the first direct participants from Africa, the Middle East, and Central Asia. Among the newly connected financial institutions is Standard Bank, Africa’s biggest lender in terms of assets. The news came out during this year’s edition of China International Finance Exhibition which gathered over 300 financial institutions in Shanghai, including around 40 foreign firms. According to local media, the event highlighted the financial hub’s role in spreading the use of the renminbi (RMB), as the Chinese yuan (CNY) is also called. The People’s Bank of China launched its cross-border payments system within a policy aimed at “internationalizing” the use of the yuan. title: OpenAI’s Ambitious AI Device Plans Unveiled Amid Legal Battle
body: BitcoinWorld OpenAI’s Ambitious AI Device Plans Unveiled Amid Legal Battle The future of personal technology is rapidly evolving, and at its forefront are titans like OpenAI and design visionary Jony Ive. Recent court filings have pulled back the curtain on their joint venture, io, revealing the ambitious early stages of their work on a mass-market AI device . For anyone tracking the convergence of artificial intelligence and consumer electronics, these revelations offer a fascinating glimpse into what could be the next major shift in how we interact with technology. What’s the Buzz About OpenAI’s AI Device? Earlier this month, legal documents submitted by lawyers representing OpenAI and Jony Ive’s io startup provided unprecedented details about their collaborative efforts. These filings stem from a trademark dispute initiated by iyO, a Google-backed hardware startup specializing in custom-molded earpieces. The lawsuit has inadvertently become a window into OpenAI’s hardware ambitions, forcing the company to even pull promotional materials related to its substantial $6.5 billion acquisition of io. OpenAI is vigorously fighting allegations of trademark infringement, but the legal battle has shed light on the intense research and development taking place. For the past year, OpenAI executives and former Apple leaders now at io have been diligently exploring various hardware concepts. This deep dive into OpenAI hardware indicates a serious commitment to bringing AI beyond screens and into our physical world. The Evolving Vision: Is it an In-Ear Device? Initially, much speculation revolved around an in-ear form factor for the OpenAI-io collaboration. Court documents confirm that both companies purchased at least 30 headphone sets to analyze existing market offerings. They even met with iyO’s leadership, demoing their in-ear technology. However, the narrative took an intriguing turn. Tang Tan, a long-time Apple executive and co-founder of io, declared in court that the prototype OpenAI CEO Sam Altman mentioned in io’s launch video is “not an in-ear device, nor a wearable device.” This statement significantly broadens the scope of what their first product might be. Tan clarified that the design is still unfinalized and the product is at least a year away from public advertisement or sale. So, if not in-ear, then what? Sam Altman has previously hinted at a “family” of AI devices. He reportedly told OpenAI employees that the prototype, once complete, would be able to fit in a pocket or sit on a desk. This “third device” would be fully aware of a user’s surroundings, complementing smartphones and laptops. OpenAI’s lawyers further stated that the company has explored a wide range of devices, including: Desktop-based and mobile Wireless and wired Wearable and portable This comprehensive exploration underscores their aim to create products that transcend traditional interfaces, truly pushing the boundaries of AI innovation . Navigating the Legal Landscape: The iyO Trademark Dispute The core of these revelations lies within the ongoing tech lawsuit . The dispute with iyO, a company focused on custom-molded earpieces, has brought to light specific interactions between the two entities. On May 1, OpenAI’s VP of Product, Peter Welinder, and io’s Tang Tan met with iyO’s CEO, Jason Rugolo, to learn about their in-ear product. This meeting, held at io’s San Francisco office, involved testing iyO’s custom-fit earpiece, which reportedly failed repeatedly during demonstrations. Tang Tan asserts he attended the meeting as a courtesy, taking precautions to avoid learning too much about iyO’s intellectual property. However, internal communications revealed that an io engineer, Marwan Rammah, suggested purchasing a large database of 3D ear scans from an iyO partner, “The Ear Project,” for “ergonomics.” It remains unclear if such a deal ever materialized. Despite these interactions, attempts by iyO’s CEO to forge a deeper partnership – including pitching iyO’s device as a “developer kit” for OpenAI’s final product, seeking investment, or even offering to sell iyO for $200 million – were declined. Evans Hankey, another io co-founder and chief product officer, has also declared that io is not developing a “custom-molded earpiece product.” This legal back-and-forth highlights the competitive nature of the burgeoning AI hardware market. The Future of AI Innovation: What’s Next for Jony Ive and OpenAI? The collaboration between OpenAI and Jony Ive represents a significant convergence of leading AI capabilities and iconic design philosophy. While smart glasses are a prominent form factor in the race for broadly adopted AI-enabled devices, with Meta and Google actively developing their own, the exploration of AI-enabled headphones by companies like Apple (rumored AirPods with cameras) indicates a diverse landscape of possibilities. OpenAI and io’s extensive research into in-ear products, even if their first offering isn’t one, shows a thorough approach to understanding user interaction and ergonomics in the context of ambient AI. Their ultimate goal, as stated by Altman, is to create products that move beyond traditional interfaces, offering a more integrated and aware technological experience. Unpacking the Challenges for a Mass-Market AI Device Developing a mass-market AI device is fraught with challenges. Beyond the technical hurdles of integrating advanced AI into compact hardware, there are significant design, user experience, and legal considerations. The iyO lawsuit itself exemplifies the complex IP landscape surrounding new technological frontiers. Ensuring privacy, managing data, and creating intuitive interactions for a device that is “fully aware of a user’s surroundings” will require groundbreaking solutions. The fact that OpenAI’s first hardware device is still over a year away from sale underscores the complexity and the meticulous development process involved. Their exploration of diverse form factors suggests a commitment to finding the most impactful and user-friendly way to introduce this “third device” into daily life, setting a new benchmark for AI innovation . The revelations from these court filings paint a vivid picture of OpenAI and io’s ambitious journey into hardware. Their meticulous research, diverse exploration of form factors, and strategic approach to a competitive market indicate a serious commitment to shaping the next generation of personal technology. While the exact nature of their first product remains somewhat elusive, it’s clear they are aiming for something transformative – a device designed to integrate seamlessly into our lives, aware of our surroundings, and poised to redefine our interaction with artificial intelligence. To learn more about the latest AI device trends, explore our article on key developments shaping AI hardware features. title: China’s Nano Labs Targets $1 Billion in BNB With $500M Raise via Convertible Notes
body: China-based Web3 infrastructure firm Nano Labs has entered into a $500 million convertible note agreement as part of a broader strategy to accumulate Binance Coin (BNB) holdings worth up to $1 billion. Key Takeaways: Nano Labs has signed a $500 million convertible note deal to begin accumulating BNB. The deal’s completion is not guaranteed and depends on standard closing conditions. The company aims to eventually hold 5–10% of BNB’s circulating supply as part of a broader digital asset strategy. In a Tuesday press release , the company announced that it has signed a convertible promissory notes purchase agreement with several unnamed investors. The notes mature in 360 days and carry no interest. Investors will have the option to convert the debt into Nano Labs’ Class A ordinary shares at a fixed price of $20 per share, subject to adjustment. The notes are unsecured and repayment is due unless converted before maturity. Deal Closing Still Uncertain Amid Pending Conditions Nano Labs said the closing of the agreement remains contingent on customary conditions and cautioned that there is no certainty the transaction will be completed in full. The capital raise marks a major step in the company’s effort to deepen its exposure to digital assets. In particular, Nano Labs plans to conduct a comprehensive evaluation of BNB’s utility, network security, and long-term value. It intends to use the proceeds to acquire BNB through a mix of convertible notes and private placements. According to the announcement, Nano Labs ultimately aims to hold between 5% and 10% of BNB’s total circulating supply, a significant target that would position the company among the largest known holders of the token outside of Binance itself. Announcement #NanoLabs has entered into a $500M convertible notes purchase agreement to launch our $BNB Strategic Reserve. $NA https://t.co/bj4nbzDUrq pic.twitter.com/i3ezU3MrcV — Nano Labs (@NanoLabsLtd) June 24, 2025 While no timeline was given for the full BNB accumulation plan, the company indicated that the current financing represents only the first stage of a larger digital asset strategy. Nano Labs operates in China’s growing Web3 sector, providing blockchain infrastructure and product solutions. The move by Nano Labs comes amid rising institutional interest in specific altcoins. Just recently, Interactive Strength, a Nasdaq-listed fitness tech firm, announced plans to raise $500 million to create a Fetch.ai token treasury, suggesting that selective altcoin bets still hold appeal. Blockstream CEO Declares Altcoin Season Over, Urges Shift to Bitcoin Treasuries Despite the rising interest in altcoin treasuries, Blockstream CEO Adam Back believes the era of altcoin speculation has ended, advising investors to rotate into Bitcoin or Bitcoin treasury stocks instead. In a recent post on X, he stated, “TSRY SZN is the new ALT SZN,” signaling a shift in sentiment as BTC-focused companies gain traction. Back’s comments align with growing institutional interest in Bitcoin. According to BitcoinTreasuries.NET, over 240 public companies now hold BTC, nearly double from earlier this month, collectively owning close to 4% of the total Bitcoin supply. The momentum behind corporate Bitcoin adoption continues to grow. On June 12, Nasdaq-listed Mercurity Fintech Holding announced an $800 million raise to establish a long-term Bitcoin reserve. Days earlier, France-based Blockchain Group revealed plans to raise $340 million for a similar move. title: Dow Jones, major indices up amid delicate Iran-Israel ceasefire
body: The Dow Jones Industrial Average, S&P 500, and Nasdaq all opened in the green on Tuesday, June 24, as Wall Street weighed the strength of the Israeli-Iran ceasefire. The Dow opened 280 points, or 0.6% higher, while the S&P 500 gained 0.7%. Meanwhile, the Nasdaq Composite rose 1%. Notably, stocks had closed higher on Monday after President Donald Trump announced that Israel and Iran had agreed to a ceasefire to end what he described as a “12-day war.” This pause in hostilities, taken as a sign of easing tensions, propelled risk assets higher, including crypto . Bitcoin ( BTC ) reclaimed $105k as a cheery market responded. Elsewhere, oil prices dipped. You might also like: Dow Jones flat amid muted reaction to U.S. strikes on Iran nuclear sites Israel, Iran violate ceasefire Market sentiment has already signaled a bullish outlook in relation to a ceasefire and end to the war. However, jitters remain and the gains are not wild. On the concerns list for most traders is the Middle East situation. Israel-Iran remains top of investors’ factors to consider because Israel accused Tehran of violating the ceasefire, vowing a major response. President Trump nonetheless has strongly urged Israel to “not drop the bombs” and to bring its pilots home. “ISRAEL. DO NOT DROP THOSE BOMBS. IF YOU DO IT IS A MAJOR VIOLATION. BRING YOUR PILOTS HOME, NOW!’ Trump wrote on Truth Social. Investors may be cautious amid this unfolding Israel-Iran situation, with prospects of an end to hostilities likely to catalyze gains. Fresh triggers to the conflict, including counter-attacks or U.S. re-entry would spook investors. “The United States is right to put pressure on both sides to comply with the ceasefire,” Michèle Flournoy, former Under Secretary of Defense, told CNBC in an interview . Flournoy however says the conflict is “far from over.” What else are investors watching? Beyond geopolitical tensions, markets are also watching macroeconomic indicators, especially upcoming tariff negotiation deadlines and potential shifts in interest rates. Positive developments on either front could provide fresh momentum for equities. This week, attention turns to Federal Reserve Chairman Jerome Powell, who is scheduled to speak Wednesday before the Senate Banking Committee.
